niche: Med spas, aesthetic clinics, cosmetic surgery & body sculpting
about: Mix-and-match sections for med spas, aesthetic/injectables clinics, cosmetic & plastic surgeons, body-sculpting, hair-restoration and skin clinics, from 12 Dribbble full-page references (1–12.webp; shot links in _sources.json). Every mockup = one base STYLE + an ordered set of SECTIONS. Crops live in sections/<id>.jpg. These designs are carried by soft, close-up skin/face photography and calm clinic interiors: use the lead's real practitioners, clinic and (consented) before/after photos first, then aesthetic stock. Medical claims, before/after results, prices, years and patient counts must come from FACTS; never invent credentials, FDA claims or medical-school affiliations — drop those blocks if not in FACTS.
